MOVED BY: HARDER
       SECONDED: YACUCHA

       THAT Council approve the February 3, 2025, Regular Meeting Agenda with the following
       amendments and renumber the agenda accordingly:

           •   Defer 8.2.1, 2025 Funding Requests to February 18, 2025

           •   Add as Item 5 — Presentation from the Mayor Re — Proposed Tariffs from the United
               States

           •   Add a new Section 14 titled "New Business" Resolution from Council with regard to
               Proposed Tariffs.

                                                                                             Motion CARRIED.

5.   PRESENTATIONS

     5.1       Presentation from Mayor Goodmanson - Proposed Tariffs from the United States

               Mayor Goodmanson presented a speech regarding the proposed tariffs from the United
               States of America.

6.   PUBLIC PARTICIPATION

     Mayor Goodmanson opened public participation at 7:09 pm.

     C. More, Langford Resident - Item 10.1 - Speaker expressed support for climate action related
     Strategic Plan initiatives and fiscal responsibility. Speaker expressed an interest in Council joining
     a class action lawsuit regarding the oil and gas industry. Item 11.2 - Speaker expressed support
     for the resolution as written.

     R. Elliott - Item 11.2 - Speaker expressed support for the resolution as written noting a need for
     additional measures to protect our coastal and marine areas. Speaker expressed support for the
     provincial Coastal Marine Strategy framework.

     A. Elgert, Vancouver Resident - Item 11.2 - Speaker expressed support for the resolution as
     written. Speaker expressed a need for additional coastal protections and measures to combat
     habitat loss and additional support and research for climate change impacts on shorelines.
     Speaker expressed support for the provincial Coastal Marine Strategy framework.

     Mayor Goodmanson noted the online attendance of Councillor Szpak, and that he regretted to
     inform those in attendance at the onset of the meeting.

     M. Pike, Oak Bay Resident - Item 8.1.1 - Speaker identified themselves as the proponent for
     Development Variance Permit (DVP24-0006 3003 Irwin Road) and could answer questions from
     Council if required.

     W. Bowers, Langford Resident - Item 11.2 - Speaker expressed support for the resolution as
     written. Item 11.1 - Speaker encouraged Council to attract more doctors to the region. 10.1 -
     Speaker noted a need to delay spending due to economic uncertainty. Item 6 - Speaker
     expressed concern with the content of the minutes of the January 13, 2025 meeting.

     N. Johal, Langford Resident - Item 6 - Speaker expressed concern with the content of the minutes
     of the meeting held January 13, 2025.

     S. Sifert, Langford Resident - Item 11.2 - Speaker expressed an interest in bringing forward a park
     naming bylaw.

     M. Wignall, Langford Resident - Item 11.1 - Speaker expressed support for the intent of the
     resolution as written but expressed concern regarding the municipality's scope. Item 11.2 -

     Speaker expressed support for the resolution as presenting noting a need for cleaner marine
     areas.

     Mayor Goodmanson closed public participation at 7:31 pm.

7.   CONSENT AGENDA
